verdict.rationale: Auth0's RBAC docs describe defining roles, assigning permissions to roles, and assigning roles to users. Its access-management material says authorization is handled using scopes and granular permissions for first-party, third-party, and M2M apps, alongside OAuth 2.0 API protection. That clearly covers the core of defining and using roles and permissions, but how they appear in tokens is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that roles/permissions are embedded as claims in access/ID tokens, detail on API-side enforcement of permission checks, and independent hands-on corroboration.
